visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of two men standing outdoors in what appears to be a campus or park. On the right, a man in a grey blazer holds a pink SSONDA branded box, while the man on the left, wearing a black vest over a light-colored shirt, points toward the box with his right hand. The background features blurred green foliage and a modern building under flat, natural daylight. (2) The man in the vest holds up a small pink spray canister. A large cartoonish explosion graphic with fire and smoke appears over the center of the frame with the text '原地起飛' in bold yellow characters. Both characters maintain neutral but focused facial expressions while gesturing toward the product. (3) The camera pulls back to a wider shot showing the two men standing on a paved walkway. The man on the left adjusts his glasses and gestures with his hands as they engage in a conversation. The setting includes trees without leaves and a large building in the distance, indicating a public outdoor area. (4) A close-up shot focuses on the hands as the man in the blazer presents the pink SSONDA box more clearly to the camera. He hands the box to the man in the vest. The details of the pink packaging, the man's silver watch, and his wedding ring are visible. (5) The scene cuts to a product showcase on a stone ledge. A black silicone cat-shaped keychain sleeve and a pink spray canister are placed in front of the pink box. Large text overlays appear on the screen describing the product's features. The lighting is bright and emphasizes the product colors. (6) A close-up demonstration shows a hand holding the small pink spray canister against a background of green bushes. The thumb is shown pressing down on the white nozzle to demonstrate the activation mechanism. The focus is sharp on the hand and the device, blurring the hedge behind. (7) A full-screen graphic appears with technical details, showing various certification logos like WIPO, AFRL, and USAF. It features pink and white text on a grey and white background, detailing safety instructions and product specifications such as the 3-5 meter range. (8) Another promotional graphic screen appears, displaying the cat keychain, the pink spray, and the black variant. Large text highlights the release date as 2025/12/18 and mentions the brand SSONDA. The layout is informative and uses a mix of icons and text. (9) The final shot returns to the two men in a medium shot. They both point downward toward the bottom of the frame where a link would typically be located. They are smiling at the camera, concluding the product endorsement with a direct call to action.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched male voice asks '噴到會怎麼樣?' over a fast-paced electronic dance music track with a strong synth beat. The background music is energetic and sets a lively tone immediately. (2) SFX: A sharp 'pop' and synthesized explosion sound occur simultaneously. A second male voice answers enthusiastically, '原地起飛!', with high arousal and a comedic tone. The BGM continues without interruption. (3) The dialogue shifts to a conversational tone about personal safety and the risks of being outdoors. Both male voices are clear and well-recorded, with moderate speech rates and friendly intonations. (4) SFX: A digital 'ding' sound cues the introduction of the product name 'SSONDA'. The primary speaker's voice remains authoritative yet approachable as he begins the product pitch. (5) SFX: A quick 'whoosh' sound marks the transition to describing the product's design features. The background music remains consistent, providing a rhythmic pulse underneath the vocal narration. (6) SFX: A realistic 'hissing' spray sound is audible during the demonstration of the nozzle. The speaker explains the patented design and the range of the spray in a professional, narrative tone. (7) SFX: An electronic UI chime accompanies the technical graphic. The narrator details the safety certifications. The BGM's percussive elements are prominent but do not interfere with vocal clarity. (8) SFX: Another 'pop' transition. The voices discuss the product's appeal as a gift for family members. The tone becomes warmer and more personal while the music maintains its high energy. (9) SFX: A final 'ping' sound signals the closing call to action. The speakers urge viewers to click the link for 'early bird' offers. The music swells slightly before a clean hard cut concludes the track.
